RUSTSEC-2023-0071.fixBlockedBy: sqlx-mysql 0.8.0 (exact pin of rsa 0.9; patched 0.10 is semver-incompatible)
RUSTSEC-2023-0071.reason: Not compiled into the binary. Present in Cargo.lock only through sqlx-mysql, which is disabled because tauri-plugin-sql is declared with features = ["sqlite"]; `cargo tree -i rsa -e normal --target all` reports no reverse dependencies. Lance performs no RSA or PKCS#1 signature verification anywhere; update signatures are minisign (Ed25519) via tauri-plugin-updater. A patched major version (rsa 0.10) exists but `cargo update -p rsa --precise 0.10.0` fails because sqlx-mysql 0.8.0 pins rsa 0.9 exactly. Re-verify with the cargo tree probe when tauri-plugin-sql is next bumped.

RUSTSEC-2024-0363.reason: Not applicable to Lance's stack. GHSA-xmrp-424f-vfpx covers the Postgres and MySQL binary wire protocol types, where truncated or overflowing casts are reinterpreted as wire-format values. Lance is SQLite-only: tauri-plugin-sql is declared with features = ["sqlite"] and the frontend plugin config preloads sqlite:lance.db, so no Postgres or MySQL code path is compiled in. A fix does exist at sqlx 0.8.1 and cannot be taken because tauri-plugin-sql pins sqlx 0.8.0, so this is recorded with fixBlockedBy rather than silently ignored. Revisit when tauri-plugin-sql publishes a release allowing sqlx >= 0.8.1; at that point delete this entry and bump.

RUSTSEC-2026-0459.fixBlockedBy: rusqlite 0.31 (requires libsqlite3-sys ^0.28; patched 0.39 needs a rusqlite major upgrade)
RUSTSEC-2026-0459.reason: Lance uses rusqlite 0.31 for an in-memory SQLite connection in tests and the Tauri SQL plugin for on-disk storage; the patched libsqlite3-sys 0.39 is semver-incompatible (`cargo update -p libsqlite3-sys --precise 0.39.0` is rejected by rusqlite ^0.31). The advisory concerns the bundled SQLite C library shipped through the sys crate; Lance's database files stay on the user's own machine and never accept remote/untrusted database files. Revisit when rusqlite can move to a release that allows libsqlite3-sys >= 0.39, then delete this entry and bump.
